meta.name: Send weekly KPI executive summaries from Google Sheets via Gemini, Gmail and Slack

name: Weekly KPI Summary Generator with Google Sheets, Gemini, Gmail and Slack

parameters.content:
## Schedule and Context
This section starts the workflow on a weekly schedule and prepares the report metadata used throughout the run. It creates the report date, title, and week label so the summary has a clear reporting context. The output from this section becomes the foundation for all later data collection and messaging.

## KPI Data Intake and Standardization

This section collects KPI data from your main Google Sheet and also pulls benchmark test data from the dummy API. It then converts both sources into one clean and consistent structure so the workflow can process them reliably. This keeps the data ready for merging, calculation, and summary generation without format issues.

## KPI Combination
This section combines the two normalized data streams and calculates the weekly performance movement for each KPI. It determines change, percentage growth, trend direction, and whether each metric is above or below target. This is the analytical core of the workflow and prepares the data for summary generation.

## Executive Summary Drafting
This section packages all KPI results into one prompt and sends it to Gemini for an executive level weekly summary. The prompt tells the model how to format the response, what to highlight, and how to keep it concise. In your current workflow, this step is already producing the final summary text successfully.

## Delivery and Logging
This section formats the summary for delivery and then sends it to email, Slack, and Google Sheets log storage. It creates one final message body, posts it to your communication channels, and stores a record of the weekly report. This gives you both live distribution and a historical archive for review.

## How workflow works
This workflow runs every week and gathers KPI values from Google Sheets and a benchmark API. It standardizes the data, merges the two sources, and calculates trend metrics such as change, percentage movement, and target status. After that, it creates one summary prompt for Gemini, which generates an executive style weekly update. The final message is then formatted for both email and Slack and saved into a Google Sheet log for future tracking. The workflow is now fully automated, repeatable, and ready for weekly reporting.

## Setup steps
1. Set the weekly trigger schedule.
2. Prepare the Google Sheet with the KPI columns.
3. Connect the Google Sheets and Slack and Gmail credentials.
4. Keep the benchmark API node only for testing or demo runs.
5. Ensure the normalize nodes output one clean structure.
6. Confirm the merge and trend calculation nodes return correct values.
7. Review the final summary, then save email and Slack delivery outputs.

assignments.name: summary_prompt
assignments.value:
=You are an executive business analyst.
Create a concise weekly KPI executive summary in simple business language.

Requirements:
1. Start with overall performance in 2 to 3 lines
2. Highlight top improvements
3. Highlight biggest declines
4. Mention metrics below target
5. End with 3 action points
6. Keep output suitable for both email and Slack
7. Use short headings only
8. Do not use markdown table

Weekly KPI data:
{{ JSON.stringify($input.all().map(i => i.json), null, 2) }}
